summary: First-finish smoke test of The Travelling Tutor MVP. All 7 backend endpoints (root, testimonials, contact, lead-magnet, newsletter [idempotent], booking, tutor-application) pass with correct schemas, UUID ids, ISO created_at, and 422 on invalid emails. Frontend home loads with correct hero copy, dual CTAs, and 3 audience cards. Booking dialog, contact form, lead-magnet form, newsletter, and tutor-partner application all submit and show explicit success states/toasts. All 12 routes render. Testimonials page renders backend data. Mobile menu toggle opens at 390px viewport. No console/page errors observed.
passed: POST /api/contact -> Contact object with id+created_at; invalid email -> 422
POST /api/newsletter -> idempotent (same id returned on duplicate email); invalid email -> 422
Homepage hero headline + hero-explore-btn + hero-book-btn + 3 audience cards render
Booking dialog opens via hero-book-btn, form submits successfully (success state)
Contact form submits and shows success
Lead magnet form (free-resources) submits and shows success
Footer newsletter submit completes without error
Testimonials page renders backend names (Amelia, Sarah)
Tutor partner apply form submits and shows 'Application received' toast
Mobile menu toggle clickable at 390px viewport
No console errors captured during full flow run
